subject: Astral Health CAIQ attestation walkthrough and control corroboration
messages:
From: Elena Varga <elena.varga@astralhealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: compliance@astralhealth.com
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ: scope + walkthrough request

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for the call last week. As we start our security intake for the procurement board, our security team asked for a CAIQ-based walkthrough and a short attestation that the controls we call out are implemented and where the evidence lives. To keep the scope tight for this first pass, could we focus on these control families:
- Access control and authentication (authentication, MFA, role-based access)
- Key management and encryption at rest/in transit
- Logging, retention and tamper-evidence (runtime telemetry)

Specifically we need:
1) A CAIQ mapping that indicates the control owner inside Redwood and the primary artifact for each control (policy, diagram, log sample).
2) A 30-minute technical walkthrough next week to validate the artifacts.
3) A short attestation email or DocuSign for the controls in-scope after the walkthrough.

Priority control examples we care about: CCM-AC-01 (auth/session management), CCM-KM-02 (key rotation), CCM-LOG-03 (log integrity/retention). If you can provide a draft mapping and a few sample artifacts prior to the walkthrough, that will speed review.

Can you confirm owners and availability? Our preferred window is Tue/Wed morning PT.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Varga
Senior InfoSec Manager | Astral Health
elena.varga@astralhealth.com
Attachment: none
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Elena Varga <elena.varga@astralhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ: scope + walkthrough request

Elena — thanks for the clear ask. We can do that.

Quick plan:
- I will own scope/attestation coordination and final response.
- Priya will own KMS/key rotation and cryptographic artifacts.
- Marissa will lead the runtime logging and telemetry walkthrough and provide log samples.

I've attached a draft CAIQ mapping (tabbed by control family) for your review and a short evidence manifest that points to the most representative artifacts. Please treat the files as pre-read; we'll update them after the walkthrough.

Proposed meeting slots (PT):
- Tue 09/21 09:30-10:00
- Tue 09/21 11:00-11:30
- Wed 09/22 09:00-09:30

If none of those work, tell us a preferred time and we'll adapt.

Attachments: astral_caiq_draft_mapping.xlsx (Excel), evidence_manifest_v2.pdf (PDF)

On the mapping you asked about — we included a column 'artifact_type' with these common stubs: policy, runbook, architecture-diagram, log-sample, rotation-policy. For quick reference:
- CCM-AC-01 -> Owner: Marcus Lin, Artifact: role-mgmt-policy.pdf (policy)
- CCM-KM-02 -> Owner: Priya Natarajan, Artifact: kms_rotation_policy.pdf (rotation policy)
- CCM-LOG-03 -> Owner: Marissa Cole, Artifact: runtime_log_sample.txt (log sample)

We'll bring Priya and Marissa to the walkthrough. If you want us to redact any PII/context from the logs prior to the meeting, say the word.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Head of Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
Attachment: astral_caiq_draft_mapping.xlsx (Excel); evidence_manifest_v2.pdf (PDF)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Varga <elena.varga@astralhealth.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ: scope + walkthrough request

Elena / Marcus — hi, Marissa here. A couple of quick clarifications ahead of the walkthrough so we're efficient:

1) Log/sample artifacts: the runtime_log_sample.txt is a synthetic, redacted extract of our production telemetry showing request ids, model_id, latency_ms, and a hashed user id. We will provide a redacted sample in the Drive link. Runtime retention policy is 90 days for token-level telemetry; audit-grade logs are retained 12 months (see evidence_manifest_v2.pdf).

2) Key management: our KMS handles envelope encryption. KMS rotation is automated via KMS policy + monthly rotation cadence; the kms_rotation_policy.pdf describes roles and rotation process. Priya can go deeper on the key lifecycle during the walkthrough.

3) Access control: for session/MFA we use SSO via Okta and scoped service accounts for runtime. We will show the role matrix and a short runbook for privileged access.

4) We will include an architecture diagram (isolation-architecture-diagram.png) showing tenant separation, network flow, and where telemetry is collected. That is referenced in the mapping.

Requested pre-reads attached to Marcus's email. Short list of artifacts we will point to during the 30-minute session:
- evidence_manifest_v2.pdf (artifact index)
- runtime_log_sample.txt (redacted sample)
- kms_rotation_policy.pdf (rotation & separation of duties)
- isolation-architecture-diagram.png (diagram)

If you want to drill into retention/export controls (where logs leave our environment), let me know and we can extend the session by 15 minutes.

Thanks — looking forward.
Marissa Cole
Senior Reliability Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
Attachment: runtime_log_sample.txt (text), evidence_manifest_v2.pdf (PDF)
From: Elena Varga <elena.varga@astralhealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: compliance@astralhealth.com
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 14:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ: scope + walkthrough request

Thanks all — Tue 09/21 11:00 PT works for us. Please send a calendar invite and the Drive folder link so our team can pull the artifacts.

A couple of administrative items: after the walkthrough we will ask for a short attestation. We can accept an emailed signed statement from an authorized Redwood executive (template attached in our system) or a DocuSign envelope. If you prefer DocuSign, I will send the envelope after the meeting.

Also, please include the HubSpot company reference AST-12345 in any deliveries so our procurement team can map artifacts back to the vendor record.

See you on 9/21.
Elena
Elena Varga
Senior InfoSec Manager | Astral Health
elena.varga@astralhealth.com
DocuSign: optional next step
Related HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/AST-12345
